minecraft:acacia_boat: A acacia boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five acacia planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
minecraft:acacia_chest_boat: A acacia boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a acacia boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
minecraft:cherry_boat: A cherry boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five cherry planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
minecraft:cherry_chest_boat: A cherry boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a cherry boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
minecraft:dark_oak_boat: A dark oak boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five dark oak planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
minecraft:dark_oak_chest_boat: A dark oak boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a dark oak boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
minecraft:mangrove_boat: A mangrove boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five mangrove planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
minecraft:mangrove_chest_boat: A mangrove boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a mangrove boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
minecraft:bamboo_raft: A flat raft made from bamboo, working just like a boat. Craft it from five bamboo planks. It carries two passengers.
minecraft:bamboo_chest_raft: A bamboo raft with a chest on board. Craft it from a bamboo raft and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
minecraft:structure_block: A block for saving and loading structures, used by map makers. It can copy a build and paste it elsewhere. It can only be obtained with commands.
minecraft:jigsaw: A block that joins pieces of structures together during world generation. Map makers use it to build villages and dungeons from parts. It can only be obtained with commands.
minecraft:turtle_helmet: A helmet made from five turtle scutes. Wearing it gives a short water breathing effect whenever you dive. It is also brewed into potions of the turtle master.
minecraft:turtle_scute: A shell piece dropped by a baby turtle when it grows up. Five craft into a turtle shell. It also repairs turtle shells.
minecraft:armadillo_scute: A scale that armadillos shed over time; brush one to collect it right away. Six scutes craft into wolf armor. It also repairs wolf armor.
minecraft:wolf_armor: Armor for tamed wolves, crafted from six armadillo scutes. It absorbs damage until it breaks, protecting your dog. You can dye it any color.
minecraft:flint_and_steel: A lighter made from an iron ingot and flint. Use it to start fires, light TNT and campfires, or open a Nether portal. Each use wears it down.
minecraft:bowl: A simple wooden bowl crafted from three planks. It holds stews and soups. You get the bowl back after eating.
minecraft:apple: A fruit dropped by oak and dark oak leaves. Eat it for a little food. Combine it with gold for a golden apple.
minecraft:bow: A ranged weapon that fires arrows; draw it longer for stronger shots. Craft it from three sticks and three string. It can be enchanted with Power, Flame and Infinity.
minecraft:arrow: Ammunition for bows, crossbows and dispensers. Craft flint, a stick and a feather into four arrows. Skeletons drop them, and tipped versions carry potion effects.
minecraft:coal: The most common fuel, mined from coal ore. One piece smelts eight items. Combine it with a stick for torches.
minecraft:charcoal: Fuel made by smelting logs or wood. It works exactly like coal in furnaces and torch recipes. It can't be crafted into a coal block, though.
minecraft:diamond: A precious gem mined deep underground. It makes the best tools and armor before netherite, plus enchanting tables and jukeboxes. Nine craft into a block of diamond.
minecraft:emerald: A green gem used as currency with villagers. Mine it from emerald ore in mountains, or earn it by trading. Nine craft into a block of emerald.
minecraft:lapis_lazuli: A blue gem mined from lapis ore. It is spent at the enchanting table and also works as blue dye. Nine craft into a lapis block.
minecraft:quartz: A white crystal mined in the Nether. It makes quartz blocks, comparators, observers and daylight detectors. Mining it gives plenty of experience.
minecraft:amethyst_shard: A purple crystal shard from amethyst clusters. It makes spyglasses, tinted glass and calibrated sculk sensors. Allays duplicate when given one while dancing.
minecraft:raw_iron: Unrefined iron dropped by iron ore. Smelt it into an iron ingot. Nine pack into a block of raw iron.
minecraft:iron_ingot: A bar of iron from smelting raw iron. It is one of the most useful materials, needed for tools, armor, buckets, rails and more. Nine pack into a block of iron.
minecraft:raw_copper: Unrefined copper dropped by copper ore. Smelt it into a copper ingot. Nine pack into a block of raw copper.
minecraft:copper_ingot: A bar of copper from smelting raw copper. It makes copper blocks, lightning rods, spyglasses and brushes. Nine pack into a copper block.
minecraft:raw_gold: Unrefined gold dropped by gold ore. Smelt it into a gold ingot. Nine pack into a block of raw gold.
minecraft:gold_ingot: A bar of gold from smelting raw gold. It makes golden tools, clocks, powered rails and golden food. Piglins trade items for it.
minecraft:netherite_ingot: The toughest metal, made from four netherite scrap and four gold ingots. Use it at a smithing table to upgrade diamond gear to netherite. Like everything netherite, it survives lava.
minecraft:netherite_scrap: A fragment from smelting ancient debris. Four scrap and four gold ingots craft into a netherite ingot. It doesn't burn in lava.
minecraft:wooden_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two planks and a stick. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
minecraft:wooden_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one plank and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
minecraft:wooden_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three planks and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
minecraft:wooden_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three planks and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
minecraft:wooden_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two planks and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
minecraft:stone_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two cobblestone and a stick. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.
minecraft:stone_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one cobblestone and two sticks. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.
minecraft:stone_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three cobblestone and two sticks. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.
minecraft:stone_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three cobblestone and two sticks. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.
minecraft:stone_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two cobblestone and two sticks. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.
minecraft:golden_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two gold ingots and a stick. Gold tools are very fast and take enchantments well, but they break quickly.
minecraft:golden_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one gold ingot and two sticks. Gold tools are very fast and take enchantments well, but they break quickly.
minecraft:golden_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three gold ingots and two sticks. Gold tools are very fast and take enchantments well, but they break quickly.
minecraft:golden_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three gold ingots and two sticks. Gold tools are very fast and take enchantments well, but they break quickly.
minecraft:golden_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two gold ingots and two sticks. Gold tools are very fast and take enchantments well, but they break quickly.
minecraft:iron_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two iron ingots and a stick. Iron tools are sturdy, reliable and cheap to repair.
minecraft:iron_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one iron ingot and two sticks. Iron tools are sturdy, reliable and cheap to repair.
minecraft:iron_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three iron ingots and two sticks. Iron tools are sturdy, reliable and cheap to repair.
minecraft:iron_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three iron ingots and two sticks. Iron tools are sturdy, reliable and cheap to repair.
minecraft:iron_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two iron ingots and two sticks. Iron tools are sturdy, reliable and cheap to repair.
minecraft:diamond_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two diamonds and a stick. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
minecraft:diamond_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one diamond and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
minecraft:diamond_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three diamonds and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
minecraft:diamond_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three diamonds and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
minecraft:diamond_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two diamonds and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
minecraft:netherite_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Upgrade a diamond sword at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Upgrade a diamond shovel at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Upgrade a diamond pickaxe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Upgrade a diamond axe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Upgrade a diamond hoe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
minecraft:stick: The most basic crafting part, made from two planks into four sticks. It is the handle of tools, torches and many other items. Dead bushes and leaves sometimes drop them too.
minecraft:mushroom_stew: A bowl of stew made from a red and a brown mushroom. Eating it fills you up well, and you keep the bowl. Milking a mooshroom with a bowl gives it too.
minecraft:string: Thread dropped by spiders and found in cobwebs. It makes bows, fishing rods, wool and scaffolding. Placed between tripwire hooks, it becomes a tripwire.
minecraft:feather: A feather dropped by chickens. It is needed for arrows and the book and quill. It also makes the brush.
minecraft:gunpowder: A grey powder dropped by creepers, ghasts and witches. It makes TNT, fire charges and firework rockets. It turns potions into splash potions.
minecraft:wheat_seeds: Seeds from breaking grass, or from harvesting wheat. Plant them on farmland to grow wheat. Chickens love them and follow you.
minecraft:wheat: A grain harvested from fully grown wheat crops. Three make bread, and it goes into cake and cookies. Cows, sheep and goats breed with it.
minecraft:bread: A loaf baked from three wheat. It is a simple, filling food. Villager farmers often trade it.
minecraft:leather_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
minecraft:leather_chestplate: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
minecraft:leather_leggings: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
minecraft:leather_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
minecraft:chainmail_helmet: Armor for your head. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
minecraft:chainmail_chestplate: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
minecraft:chainmail_leggings: Armor for your legs. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
minecraft:chainmail_boots: Armor for your feet. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
minecraft:iron_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
minecraft:iron_chestplate: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
minecraft:iron_leggings: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
minecraft:iron_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
minecraft:diamond_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
minecraft:diamond_chestplate: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
minecraft:diamond_leggings: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
minecraft:diamond_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
minecraft:golden_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
minecraft:golden_chestplate: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
minecraft:golden_leggings: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
minecraft:golden_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
minecraft:netherite_helmet: Armor for your head. Upgrade diamond helmet at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_chestplate: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Upgrade diamond chestplate at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_leggings: Armor for your legs. Upgrade diamond leggings at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
minecraft:netherite_boots: Armor for your feet. Upgrade diamond boots at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
minecraft:flint: A sharp stone sometimes dropped by gravel. It makes arrows and flint and steel. Fletchers buy it.
minecraft:porkchop: Raw meat dropped by pigs and hoglins. Eating it raw gives little food. Cook it for a much better meal.
minecraft:cooked_porkchop: A cooked porkchop, one of the most filling foods. Cook raw porkchop in a furnace, smoker or campfire. Pigs drop it already cooked if they die in fire.
minecraft:painting: A decoration made from eight sticks and wool. Place it on a wall to show a random painting that fits the space. It can be up to four by four blocks.
minecraft:golden_apple: An apple wrapped in eight gold ingots. Eating it gives regeneration and absorption. It also cures zombie villagers when combined with a splash potion of weakness.
minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple: A rare glowing apple found only in chests. Eating it gives strong regeneration, absorption, resistance and fire resistance. It can't be crafted.
minecraft:oak_sign: A oak sign for short notes and labels. Craft six oak planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:spruce_sign: A spruce sign for short notes and labels. Craft six spruce planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:birch_sign: A birch sign for short notes and labels. Craft six birch planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:jungle_sign: A jungle sign for short notes and labels. Craft six jungle planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:acacia_sign: A acacia sign for short notes and labels. Craft six acacia planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:cherry_sign: A cherry sign for short notes and labels. Craft six cherry planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:dark_oak_sign: A dark oak sign for short notes and labels. Craft six dark oak planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:mangrove_sign: A mangrove sign for short notes and labels. Craft six mangrove planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
